blockers.description: RTL28 physical port layout remains candidate rather than hardware-approved.
The official OperatorSpec and handlers do not transport typed qparams/constants.
INT32-to-UINT8 requant rounding, saturation and target execution are not closed.
Bias and first/middle/last-K INT32 psum lifecycle are not bound to official fields.
No official INT8 SA Conv template and accumulator contract is available.
The audited Add-Dequant template ends in FP32 and does not consume output qparams.
No audited standalone one-input UINT8-to-FP32 Dequantize configuration exists.
Persistent INT32 psum and SA-to-GA requant boundaries are unbound.
The audited quant template consumes INT32, not ONNX QuantizeLinear FP32 input.
Nearest-even and saturation were inferred but not executed by an approved target model.
The static AvgPool sum template does not prove subtraction of input zero point.
Division by the spatial count and UINT8 requant are absent from the audited template.
All audited SA GEMM/GEMV templates are FP16 rather than INT8/INT32.
M=16 and N=1000 tail rules are absent and current floor division omits work.
C4 shape-to-LC rules cover audited samples but are not approved as a general generator.
Signed int8_max behavior has not been proven equivalent to UINT8 MaxPool.
Static full-event wiring does not establish the hardware completion protocol.
Remote-sum names do not prove N2N/neighbor transport or cross-slice reduction.
